svg.title: Follow until the cross
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of test_track() from Lesson 2-8. A taped circle has a short cross strip across it near the top right. The robot starts on the circle near the bottom, pointed along the line, waits for the button, then follows the line counterclockwise, weaving slightly as it steers by the error. Beside it, the outline of track_to_intersection(): while not is_at_cross, follow; then stop the motors. A box shows the live left and right readings and is_at_cross(): while following, at most one sensor reads high and is_at_cross() stays False. When both sensors reach the cross strip both read about 0.8, is_at_cross() becomes True, the loop ends and the robot stops with its sensors on the cross.
svg.text: The loop line does the looking; the

g.text: robot on the circle, pointed along it
one sensor high at a time: keep going
both sensors on tape at once
